children: said on Monday that it had received revised offers from the three active bidders, SG Fleet, Japan's ORIX
, sending the vehicle leasing firm's shares to a record high.
SG Fleet has increased its offer to A$4.55 per share, while ORIX and Sumitomo have raised their individual offers to A$4.65 ($3.32).
FleetPartners' stock jumped nearly 12% to a record high of A$4.6 in early trading.
